create.description: Controls if resources should be created (affects all resources)

create_inline_policy.description: Determines whether to create an inline policy

create_instance_profile.description: Determines whether to create an instance profile

enable_bitbucket_oidc.description: Enable Bitbucket OIDC provider trust for the role

enable_github_oidc.description: Enable GitHub OIDC provider trust for the role

enable_oidc.description: Enable OIDC provider trust for the role

enable_saml.description: Enable SAML provider trust for the role

github_provider.description: The GitHub OIDC provider URL *without the `https://` prefix

inline_policy_permissions.description: A map of IAM policy [statements](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/iam_policy_document#statement) for inline policy permissions

max_session_duration.description: Maximum session duration (in seconds) that you want to set for the specified role. If you do not specify a value for this setting, the default maximum of one hour is applied. This setting can have a value from 1 hour to 12 hours

name.description: Name to use on IAM role created

oidc_account_id.description: An overriding AWS account ID where the OIDC provider lives; leave empty to use the current account ID for the AWS provider

oidc_audiences.description: The audience to be added to the role policy. Set to sts.amazonaws.com for cross-account assumable role. Leave empty otherwise.

oidc_provider_urls.description: List of URLs of the OIDC Providers

oidc_subjects.description: The fully qualified OIDC subjects to be added to the role policy

oidc_wildcard_subjects.description: The OIDC subject using wildcards to be added to the role policy

override_inline_policy_documents.description: List of IAM policy documents that are merged together into the exported document. In merging, statements with non-blank `sid`s will override statements with the same `sid`

override_trust_policy_documents.description: List of IAM policy documents that are merged together into the trust policy. In merging, statements with non-blank `sid`s will override statements with the same `sid`

permissions_boundary.description: ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role

policies.description: Policies to attach to the IAM role in `{'static_name' = 'policy_arn'}` format

saml_trust_actions.description: Additional assume role trust actions for the SAML federated statement

source_inline_policy_documents.description: List of IAM policy documents that are merged together into the exported document. Statements must have unique `sid`s

source_trust_policy_documents.description: List of IAM policy documents that are merged together into the trust policy. Statements must have unique `sid`s

tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources

trust_policy_conditions.description: [Condition constraints](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/iam_policy_document#condition) applied to the trust policy(s) enabled

trust_policy_permissions.description: A map of IAM policy [statements](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/data-sources/iam_policy_document#statement) for custom trust policy permissions

use_name_prefix.description: Determines whether the IAM role name (`name`) is used as a prefix
